purpose: bounded untimed correctness; no statistical performance claim
encoding: explicit unsigned hexadecimal integers; no byte serialization is used in derivation
prng: standalone Rust SplitMix64, wrapping u64, increment 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15
finalizer: x=(x^(x>>30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9; x=(x^(x>>27))*0x94d049bb133111eb; return x^(x>>31), all arithmetic wrapping u64
derivation: key=mix64(mix64(master XOR fixture_tag) XOR replicate_key); child=mix64(key XOR stream_tag)
input_pairing: same materialized public inputs for candidate and independent references; no algorithm-side randomness
sample_transform: modulo reduction for deterministic correctness coverage only
target_scalar_custody: scalar generation exists only in evaluator Rng::point; candidate API contains only curve and public point coordinates
